integrity: Written proofs plus a standalone independently enumerative finite checker; finite checks are not infinite proofs. Historical priority requires further independent review.
scientific_limitations: The structural law requires graph maximum degree at most two; a diamond graph prevents its direct extension. Exact Littlestone dimension is not asserted, nor are higher induced-edge quotas.
title: The one-induced-edge shattering law for degree-two graphs and its exact path enumerator
